superpixel_color_texture_features — SEGMENTATION plant op

• Data kinds: rgbimage × labels2d → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.superpixel_color_texture_features(rgb, labels, *, dark_floor: 'float' = 0.02, texture_sigma: 'float' = 1.0, min_size: 'int' = 4) -> 'Dict[str, object]' (to call the implementation directly, import cropweed; cropweed.superpixel_color_texture_features(rgb, labels, *, dark_floor: 'float' = 0.02, texture_sigma: 'float' = 1.0, min_size: 'int' = 4) -> 'Dict[str, object]'; from the registry, opssegmentation.get("superpixel_color_texture_features"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Ten colour (plant indices, chromaticity) and texture (gradient, orientation coherence) features for every region of a label image.

rgb is (H, W, 3) (same rules as plant_color_index); labels is an integer image of the same size (0 = ignore, 1 and up = regions; superpixels or a grid both work). Columns follow FEATURE_NAMES:

means of ExG, ExGR and CIVE, means of chromaticity r and g, mean and standard deviation of brightness (mean of RGB), mean magnitude of the Gaussian gradient of brightness (σ = texture_sigma), structure-tensor orientation coherence coherence = √((Jxx − Jyy)² + 4Jxy²)/(Jxx + Jyy) (tensor summed over the region; 1 = one direction, 0 = isotropic), standard deviation of ExG. Colour features average only pixels at least as bright as dark_floor. Regions with fewer than min_size pixels, and regions with no pixel whose chromaticity is defined, get no row and are listed in dropped_ids with a reason (the mean is not filled with 0 or NaN).

Returns: X (N, 10), names, ids (region number per row), sizes, centroids ((N, 2) [row, col]), dropped_ids, texture_sigma. Empty input, shape mismatch, negative labels and zero remaining regions raise ValueError.
